meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能驱动真实浏览器:打开网页、填写表单、点击元素、截图录屏、读取页面文字,还能对比页面差异、保存登录状态。
howto.when: 当你需要做网页操作时触发,如导航网站、填表单、截图等;要测试网页应用或提取网页信息时也会用上。

say.text: 打开 example.com/form,填好邮箱和密码后点提交
say.note: 会打开页面、填入表单并点击提交按钮

say.text: 截一张带编号标注的全页图,标出可点击元素
say.note: 生成标注截图,编号对应 @eN 引用

say.text: 对比 v1 和 v2 两个网址的页面差异并截图
say.note: 用 diff url 比较两个地址

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can drive a real browser: open pages, fill forms, click elements, take screenshots and recordings, read page text, diff pages, and save session state.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need browser actions such as navigating sites, filling forms, or taking screenshots, or when testing a web app and extracting page content.

say_en.text: Open example.com/form, fill in the email and password, then click submit
say_en.note: It opens the page, fills the fields, clicks submit

say_en.text: Take a full-page screenshot with numbered labels on clickable elements
say_en.note: Produces an annotated shot tied to @eN refs

say_en.text: Diff the pages at v1 and v2 and screenshot the differences
say_en.note: Runs diff url across both addresses
